validity_findings.description: Meta-analytic mean (canonical+weighted)/2 is mathematically guaranteed to rank between the two originals whenever canonical<weighted strictly. Recomputation confirms canonical<mean<weighted on all 21/21 pairs (100%, ranking_position_distribution position_1_count 21). Therefore C2_NONDEGENERATE_EXISTS (>=1 pair with 10%<dominance<90%) and C3_THIRD_RECIPE_DISTINCT (>=3 ranking changes) are a priori impossible given the observed strict ordering, not an empirical discrimination. Producer correctly discloses this as mathematical identity (OBS-1, VN-1, VN-5) and verdicts FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, but hypothesis required task-dependent sensitivity to produce non-degeneracy which cannot occur with a linear combination. The experiment correctly falsifies the linear-recipe hypothesis, but information gain is limited to demonstrating the tautology, not to external variability.

claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: Adding a linear meta-analytic mean recipe (canonical+weighted)/2 does NOT break the 2-recipe dominance degeneracy under the OECD/COINr framework on truncated-first-20 data (7 tasks: 3 product_listing, 3 detail, 1 cart; 1 site Magento; 3 definitions DEF-FULL-MAP, DEF-FORM-ONLY, ISOLATED-A-LINK; locatable_sample cap 20). All 3 pairwise dominances remain degenerate 0%/100%, mean ranks strictly between on 21/21 pairs, 0 non-degenerate and 0 distinct rankings, null shuffled mean yields more non-degeneracy (~1.99) than real (0). The degeneracy is therefore NOT solely a 2-recipe mathematical artifact for this density metric and this linear third recipe; it persists because canonical<weighted strictly on every pair (31x gap) and linear interpolation preserves ordering. This is bounded to linear combination third recipes; it does NOT generalize to non-linear/structural third recipes (DOM hierarchy, semantic weighting), to full-DOM enumeration (blocked by runtime locatableSample cap), to cross-site, or to alternative MIXED frameworks (density ratio, reversal rate). The MIXED outcome decision rule remains UNRESOLVED; density program must pivot to non-linear recipe or alternative metric before a full-DOM re-run. C-MEAS-VALID remains EXPERIMENTAL.
